checks: Negative control: a naive reused key exposes the retained old Current marker without a read
Fresh per-view cache identity withholds old data even when old snapshots remain cached
A refused first read never reveals the retained earlier session snapshot
One explicit recovery reads a current marker from the current view
Leaving cancels the pending page; its late answer cannot enter a new view
Explicit view reset after credential rotation does not reuse a previous Current marker
The real handler-style null-session transition hides data even with cached pages retained
Expiry is not replayed by focus, reconnect or invalidation
scope: TanStack observer/cache prototype only; synthetic rows, no React mount/StrictMode, HTTP, browser, SQL or durable revocation
strategy: ephemeral view key plus explicit reset on auth/credential transition; server authority remains unchanged
